title: Pentagon confirms Navy thermal footage

tellings.quote: what's so interesting about this footage is it has now been confirmed by the Pentagon that it is actual Navy filmed footage

plain: The Pentagon has confirmed that a piece of thermal-camera UFO footage was really filmed by the Navy, according to the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell, who publishes leaked UFO videos. Corbell tells Michels this is what makes the footage interesting, since it means the military itself stands behind it as real Navy film.
